dataset_source: FATA Health Department, WHO and modified by OCHA- Pakistan
methodology_other: Each health facility location has been identified through NGA/ FATA Secretariat Gazetteer using ArcGIS; The health facilities locations which were not available in the gazetteer was identified by the field staff through the catchment villages.The asterik " * " was then written with the name of the health facility for record keeping. The final dataset lists 1043 health facilities in FATA province.
name: health-facilities-in-khyber-pakhtunkhwa-tribal-districts
notes: This dataset contains the geographic location of the health facilities located in the context of the FATA Health Department, WHO and OCHA- Pakistan.
